bio.text: Scott Franklin represents Florida's 18th Congressional District; he was first elected in 2020 and sworn in for a third term on January 3, 2025.
He served 26 years as a Naval Aviator, 14 on active duty and 12 in the reserves, and was a Lakeland City Commissioner before running for Congress.
He is a 1986 graduate of the U.S. Naval Academy, holds an MBA from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, and led the Lakeland insurance firm Lanier Upshaw for 20 years.
